thread:
Jess (Acme): Hey team — Console shows $200 trial credits on our org page but when we call the usage API with our project service key we get back a balance of 0 and tokens are being charged. Can someone help?

maria_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the output of `GET /v1/billing/credits?project_id=proj_...` (curl is fine) and confirm which account you see the credits on in the dashboard (org vs project view)? Also which service key are you using (redacted key id ok).

Jess (Acme): here's the curl output (redacted):
```
$ curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/billing/credits?project_id=proj-acme
{
  "project_id": "proj-acme",
  "credit_balance": 0,
  "applied_grants": []
}
```
Dashboard screenshot shows credits at org level: Grants -> Acme Org -> $200 (Promo: SUMMER2025) — visible only when I view the org as owner.

maria_support: Thanks — that helps. Tagging billing: @sam_billing and eng for propagation check.

sam_billing: Looking at internal ledger, I see the promo grant `grant_9012` attached to `org_acme` with amount 200. It was created yesterday. It did not appear in the `project_credit_allocations` table for `proj-acme`. Likely propagation job failed for that org.

maria_support: Any quick mitigation? Customer is being charged right now.

sam_billing: We can do a targeted resync for that org. Running `billing-cli ledger-resync --org org_acme --propagate`. That will create a `project_allocate` record for projects that should inherit org grants. I'll run it in staging first, then prod.

tyler_eng: FYI there was a deploy of the fund-propagator last night and a feature-flag `propagate-org-grants` got flipped back to off for some orgs during rollout. That would explain why grant exists at org scope but not projected to projects.

sam_billing: Kicking resync now in prod (outage risk: minimal, just DB writes). Command: 
```
# run on prod billing-leader
/opt/redwood/bin/billing-cli ledger-resync --org org_acme --propagate --dry-run=false 
```
I'll paste logs when done.

billing-bot: job started: resync-2025-06-03-17-12 (pid 4821)

maria_support: looping Jess in — @Jess (Acme) we will run this now and confirm when credits show up in API responses.

billing-bot: resync-2025-06-03-17-12 completed: created 1 allocation(s) for proj-acme; grant_9012 -> allocation_334; credits queued for immediate application.

sam_billing: I see allocation_334 linked to proj-acme and effective_at=now. You should see `applied_grants` populate. Can you re-run your curl?

Jess (Acme): reran it a minute ago, new output:
```
{
  "project_id": "proj-acme",
  "credit_balance": 200,
  "applied_grants": ["grant_9012"]
}
```
Awesome — tokens stopped charging. Thank you! :raised_hands:

maria_support: Great news. Root cause: propagation job missed due to feature-flagged rollout. Action items: (1) sam to add retry & alert on failed propagations, (2) tyler to ensure feature-flag gating has runbook for progressive rollout, (3) support to confirm any other org grants created during the window and run resync where needed.

sam_billing: Filed ticket BI-4827 to add monitoring and automatic retry on propagation failures.

tyler_eng: I'll add runbook steps and a checklist for flag rollbacks.

maria_support: Closing once customer confirms no further issues. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Jess (Acme): Confirmed, all good. Thanks for the quick fix!
